Global Metadata: Chinese guqin instrumental, 62 BPM, D minor pentatonic with a lowered sixth, solemn and quietly ominous, an ancient beast's lair at dusk, slow and unhurried throughout, no vocals at all.
Vocal Details: fully instrumental, no voice, no humming, no choir, no lyrics.
Arrangement: solo guqin with sparse plucked notes and long silences, a low bamboo flute (xiao) drifting far behind, a single deep struck stone every few phrases, faint distant wind and paper texture, large empty-hall reverb, no drums, no percussion, no bass, never building to a climax.
